g.text: Read through the J++ lens, the pointer looks like a random direction
Descriptive. The J++ lens at L on the bridge word, 200 cases per model: a pointer write (dose 2×), an
identity change and 200 random draws of the same size (grey: their median to their most extreme 5%).
